title: Logsytech Group — claimed by thegentlemen
description: FR · Technology · logsytech.fr Logsytech Group is a French logistics holding company based in Émerainville near Paris, founded in 2001 and acquired by D-Groupe Logistique in December 2022. With 160 employees, 7 warehouses totaling 30,000 square meters and 4 million shipments per year, it provides e-commerce, telecom, IoT and marketing logistics services.
